# Incidents

August 13, 2026

Table of contents

[How to Configure Incident Settings](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/776361-incidents#h_e5a276cb80)[How to Add a New Incident](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/776361-incidents#h_2316177786)[How to Resolve an Incident](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/776361-incidents#h_42bc38a316)

**Overview**

The Incidents module allows you to track, manage, and resolve incidents within your organization.

* * *

# How to Configure Incident Settings

1. Navigate to **Settings**.

2. Select **Compliance**, then click **Incidents**.


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/170965630/cec7bc429202aae8ff231b841f33/CleanShot+2026-08-13+at+11_40_06.png?expires=1794341700&signature=08b6e9ca6b213f40dfafd0ebf43b2fdc54bec8115b7e966263c4d9f8e00bd4b8&req=0dJvzF7%2FqjQolxv889osp1FNt84lvIJKyneARswYp%2BcfB9dVqp3eLkCzsfFZ%0AX1q62jEL8uK5IUWYpQ%3D%3D%0A)

**From the settings page, you can customize the following:**

- **Folders:** Organize your incidents by category or department.

- **Custom Fields:** Create specific data fields your team has to fill out when adding a new incident.

- **Resolution Fields:** Create custom fields that appear when an incident is being resolved.


**Note:** For detailed instructions on building fields, refer to our guide on **[Custom Fields](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/566891-custom-fields)**.

* * *

# How to Add a New Incident

1. Navigate to **Compliance**.

2. Select **Incidents**.

3. Click the **Add Incident** button.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/170966973/bdc190262795cfc3eaa0daa44f98/CleanShot+2026-08-13+at+11_43_35.png?expires=1794341700&signature=1c4f6f2e5ae3f44b87cb4680c95fd496d5f48d50e21f63969308e1b8f5063bdb&req=0dJvzF78pTArlxv889osp2OeET5oFXUUvJbCewZRU1j6ZyAIZoic80T74aW6%0AamI%3D%0A)

4. Fill out the incident details. The following preset fields are required: **Name, Date of occurrence, Time of incident, Date of discovery and Time of discovery.**





And complete any additional or custom fields.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/170967734/8e5b80704b0131cd70b154bc255a/CleanShot+2026-08-13+at+11_45_55.png?expires=1794341700&signature=66f9a7e7089a152f7b4af8af56a9fdb4606567b7df9d696896dfdd5d68d568ac&req=0dJvzF79qzQslxv889osp1FdRX8kcGord7DVP7Jp0pKdIUl5AKZErtCLdhLT%0An4U%3D%0A)

5. Click **Create** to log the incident into the system.


* * *

# How to Resolve an Incident

1. Navigate to your **Incidents** and click the relevant incident.

2. The **Resolve incident** panel will appear on the right.

3. Fill out all required resolution fields, including: **Description, Resolution Date** and any other relevant information.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/170969226/fc4cb79966080918a17fe23cb2e6/CleanShot+2026-08-13+at+11_49_00.png?expires=1794341700&signature=b8bd39274314e3a6c3b163dd19de804a494bfa0ca1c7e3dd6ebb08c4d2aa18fd&req=0dJvzF7zrjUulxv889ospwUZcrIswtcuVTaXzjVdMi1CPTlr962Ef032IhAe%0AO9I%3D%0A)

4. Click **Resolve Incident** to close it.


All submitted details remain securely stored in the incident's Resolution section.

An incident can always be reopened if needed.

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/170970469/35df3db7539a4707f08b6af6e98b/CleanShot+2026-08-13+at+11_52_27.png?expires=1794341700&signature=ef51459cf161450e387a4f3fa0db2664b2fdbaa4cb178d3a7b1ab3d807f776af&req=0dJvzF%2F6qDEhlxv889osp2DX0r2q1Z0imIpjKMTSqqAF7bD%2B99RUWThmC%2FRt%0A1QKITYuAvnHBUeYFBA%3D%3D%0A)
